program.identity: Electronics / Micro-Electronics Labs District — The Signal Spine
program.architecturalLanguage: graphite ceramic, pale technical porcelain, titanium, oxidized copper, black glass, controlled photonic coatings, and translucent fluoropolymer enlarged into a semiconductor ecosystem rather than applied motherboard ornament

buildings.name: Fabrica Ångström
buildings.subtitle: Advanced Logic Foundry
buildings.focus: Stacked CFET logic, nanosheet and forksheet devices, backside contacting, advanced power delivery, and heterogeneous semiconductor channels
buildings.exteriorSignature: two immense transistor volumes divided by a dielectric seam, eight structural gate loops, dense forksheet fins, backside copper power delivery, and disciplined white air-handling crowns

buildings.name: The Interposer Exchange
buildings.subtitle: Chiplet and 3D Integration Complex
buildings.focus: Heterogeneous chiplets, advanced packaging, silicon interposers, hybrid bonding, high-bandwidth memory, and high-density interfaces
buildings.exteriorSignature: eight heterogeneous chiplet buildings on a routed substrate podium, ribbed data bridges, glass microbump columns, and an asynchronous roofscape

buildings.name: Lumen Weave Institute
buildings.subtitle: Photonic and Optoelectronic Circuits
buildings.focus: Silicon photonics, optical interconnects, integrated lasers, modulation, sensing, and electronic-photonic integration
buildings.exteriorSignature: two curved iridescent wings forming an incomplete ring resonator, etched waveguides, a continuous pearlescent ribbon, calibration domes, and black optical pools

buildings.name: Kelvin Null Center
buildings.subtitle: Cryogenic Control Electronics
buildings.focus: Cryogenic CMOS control, low-noise signal generation, qubit readout, calibration, and reduced-wiring quantum interfaces
buildings.exteriorSignature: three visually separated thermal cylinders, heavy maintenance rings, vacuum-jacketed umbilicals, helium recovery vessels, radiator fins, and a concentric frost plaza

buildings.name: Synaptic Stack Laboratory
buildings.subtitle: Neuromorphic and Memristive Electronics
buildings.focus: Memristors, artificial synapses, analog neural hardware, event-driven computation, and three-dimensional memory-compute integration
buildings.exteriorSignature: three oxide-red dendritic wings beneath a graphite matrix tower, slow electrochromic memory fields, a repeatedly branching canopy, and pressure-responsive pavement nodes

buildings.name: The Spin-Orbit Vault
buildings.subtitle: Magnetic Memory and Spintronic Systems
buildings.focus: MRAM, magnetic tunnel junctions, spin-orbit switching, antiferromagnetic devices, spintronic memristors, and magnetic neural hardware
buildings.exteriorSignature: a low ferrite core behind two incomplete domain walls, fixed moiré fins, radial roof fields, tangential entrances, and slowly reorienting plaza stones

buildings.name: Aegis Power Bastion
buildings.subtitle: Wide- and Ultra-Wide-Bandgap Electronics
buildings.focus: Silicon carbide, gallium nitride, gallium oxide, diamond, high-field packaging, thermal management, grid conversion, and pulsed power
buildings.exteriorSignature: two heat-sink laboratory bastions around a shielded test canyon, glass-fronted copper busbars, ceramic buttresses, radiator towers, and grounded artificial-tree masts

buildings.name: The Terahertz Metrology Spire
buildings.subtitle: RF, Millimeter-Wave and Submillimeter Electronics
buildings.focus: High-frequency circuits, on-wafer characterization, terahertz calibration, phased arrays, over-the-air measurements, and traceable metrology
buildings.exteriorSignature: a faceted square-to-octagonal tower with phased-array crown and needle radome above three black anechoic courts, a surveyed calibration line, and twisting waveguide bridges

buildings.name: The Adaptive Skin Pavilion
buildings.subtitle: Flexible, Printed and Biointegrated Electronics
buildings.focus: Stretchable circuits, organic conductors, electronic skin, flexible neural interfaces, tissue-conformal sensors, and biohybrid devices
buildings.exteriorSignature: a low folded translucent membrane over branching frames, conductive inner meshes, fibre canopies, warm-water basins, bioswales, and protected printed sensor ribbons

buildings.name: Sensorium Hive
buildings.subtitle: MEMS, NEMS and In-Sensor Computing Laboratory
buildings.focus: MEMS and NEMS, multifunctional sensor arrays, event-driven vision, analog edge processing, and devices that sense and compute together
buildings.exteriorSignature: twelve modality-specific hexagonal and circular sensing volumes around an open calibration field, a cable-borne sensor canopy, microclimate needles, and branching test paths
